motions.motion_text: Deputy Mayor Wilson moved, seconded by Morzel to approve consent items 3A through 3H with amendments to items 3A and 3D.

Council Member Gray moved, seconded by Morzel to adopt Ordinance No. 7716 amending Title 6 by the addition of a new chapter 6-14, "Medical Marijuana," B.R.C. 1981; terminating interim regulations adopted by Ordinance No. 7707; adding a new section 4-20-64, "Medical Marijuana Dispensaries," to Chapter 4-20, "Fees," B.R.C.1981; amending Title 5 by adding crimes related to anti-personnel devices; and setting forth related details.

Council Member Becker moved, seconded by Wilson to remove the underline on page 30, lines 15-17. The following sentence in section (f) deleted: "Provided however, deliver of medical marijuana from the licensed premises to a patient may be permitted in the event a patient has an emergency need for medical marijuana prior to 7 a.m. of the following day. In such case, the delivery shall be no more medical marijuana than is required to meet the need of the patient to address the emergency."

Council Member Ageton moved, seconded by Cowles to delete Sections 3 and 4 of the ordinance on page 38 of the memo and introduce and order published by title only a new Ordinance No. 7723 as presented in the green supplemental handout provided by the City Attorney, amending Title 5 "General Offenses," B.R.C. 1981 by adding crimes related to anti-personnel devices, and setting forth related details.

Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Becker to amend section (i) by deleting "or Offset" in the subject and removing "...Certified Renewable Energy Credits ("RECs") or carbon offsets. For purposes of this section RECs or offsets means independently certified carbon credits established through programs such as Green E.

Council Member Appelbaum moved, seconded by Morzel to amend Section (a) subsection (2) on page 21 of the memo by deleting "is located as allowed in Ordinance No. 7707" and inserting "was established as a greenhouse/nursery use and prior to "commenced operation.."
Council Member Morzel moved, seconded by Ageton to suspend the rules and continue the meeting at 10:35 p.m.

Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Becker to incorporate the yellow supplemental handout provided by the City Attorney amending page 32, line 18 of "Records of Sources of Medical Marijuana" by adding a new subsection (e) to 6-14-9: (e) Reporting of Source, Quantity and Sales. The records to be maintained by each licensee shall include the source and quantity of any marijuana distributed, produced or possessed upon the licensed premises. Such reports shall include without limitation for both acquisitions from wholesalers and transactions to patients or caregivers the following: 1. Name and address of seller or purchaser; 2. Date, weight, type of marijuana and dollar amount or other consideration of transaction; and 3. For wholesale transactions, the Colorado, and city if any, sales and use tax license number of the seller. And deleting Section 6-14-12(b) on page 34, lines 6-8 as shown on the yellow handout provided by the City Attorney.

Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Wilson to incorporate the blue supplemental handout provided by the City Attorney amending page 32, line 18 by adding a new Subsection (e) to 6-14-9: (e) Reporting of Energy Use and Renewable Energy Credit (REC) Purchases. The records to be maintained by each licensee that grows medical marijuana shall include without limitation records showing on a monthly basis the use and source of energy and the number of certified Renewable Energy Credits (RECs) purchased, or the subscription level for another renewable energy acquisition program approved by the city manager. Such records shall include all statements, reports or receipts to verify the items included in the report of the licensee. By acceptance of the medical marijuana business license from the city, the licensee grants permission to providers of the energy or point of origin of the RECs or other renewable energy acquisition program to disclose the records of the licensee to the city.
Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Morzel to amend page 28, line 21 by adding "except that this limitation shall not apply in Industrial Zones."
Council Member Ageton moved, seconded by Morzel to suspend the rules and continue the meeting at 11:00 p.m.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:2; Cowles and Karakehian opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Gray moved, seconded by Morzel to amend page 28, lines 14 and 16 in section (e) subsection (1) inserting "and for personal service uses, within 500' of a City Parks and Recreation park or center, excluding the Boulder Creek Path, Pearl Street Mall and Flatirons Golf Course."
motions.vote_text: The motion failed 3:6; Gray, Morzel and Osborne in favor.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Wilson moved, seconded by Becker to strike the last sentence in (e) (1) on page 28 of the memo that reads "This restriction shall not apply to any applicant who applied for a business license for a medical marijuana business prior to November 5, 2009, such license was approved and the business has continuously operated such business since December 1, 2009."
motions.vote_text: The motion failed 4:5; Ageton, Appelbaum, Cowles, Karakehian and Morzel opposed.

motions.motion_text: Vote was taken on the main motion to adopt Ordinance No. 7716 amending Title 6 by the addition of a new chapter 6-14, "Medical Marijuana," B.R.C. 1981; terminating interim regulations adopted by Ordinance No. 7707; adding a new section 4-20-64, "Medical Marijuana Dispensaries," to Chapter 4-20, "Fees," B.R.C.1981; amending Title 5 by adding crimes related to anti-personnel devices; and setting forth related details. The motion included the errata sheet amending page 37, line 17 and page 38, line 2 as listed above.
Council ratified the appointment of Council Member Becker to the Boulder Urban Renewal Authority Board.
There was a motion to revisit the Crestview East annexation issues related to sidewalks and trees.
motions.vote_text: The motion failed 3:6; Gray, Cowles and Morzel in favor.

motions.motion_text: BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 11:50 P.M.

agenda_items.section: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: PUBLIC SERVICE RECOGNITION WEEK DECLARATION. – 6:02 P.M.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Osborne read a declaration honoring public servants and declaring May 3 – 9, 2010 as public service recognition week in the City of Boulder.

agenda_items.section: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: XCEL ENERGY FRANCHISE PRESENTATION. – 6:05 P.M.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Xcel Energy presented its franchise renewal proposal, and the Council discussed the benefits and concerns regarding the agreement.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The Council heard public comments regarding the Xcel franchise, Arizona immigration laws, and homelessness, and discussed staff and council responses.

agenda_items.title: CONSENT AGENDA:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The Council approved consent items 3A through 3H with amendments to items 3A and 3D.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE No. 7716 AMENDING TITLE 6 BY THE ADDITION OF A NEW CHAPTER 6-14, “MEDICAL MARIJUANA,” B.R.C. 1981; TERMINATING INTERIM REGULATIONS ADOPTED BY ORDINANCE No. 7707; ADDING A NEW SECTION 4-20-64, “MEDICAL MARIJUANA DISPENSARIES,” TO CHAPTER 4-20, “FEES,” B.R.C.1981; AMENDING TITLE 5 BY ADDING CRIMES RELATED TO ANTI-PERSONNEL DEVICES; AND SETTING FORTH RELATED DETAILS.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The Council adopted Ordinance No. 7716 with several amendments regarding medical marijuana licensing, fees, and renewable energy requirements.

agenda_items.outcome_summary: No items were listed for the City Manager.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY ATTORNEY:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: No items were listed for the City Attorney.

agenda_items.title: DISCUSSION REGARDING THE BOULDER URBAN RENEWAL AUTHORITY BOARD APPOINTMENT.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Osborne appointed Council Member Becker to the Boulder Urban Renewal Authority Board, and the Council ratified the appointment.

agenda_items.title: ADJOURNMENT
